lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in multiple horizontal rows across the lateral flank, posterior to the gill region, forming a semi-regular 2D grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating distinct grid-like anchor nodes across the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal linear feature is visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on its dorsal edge to shadow on its ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the visible pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small, high-luminance spots.
